item.title: Southern Boone to debut in Central Bank Great 8 Classic field | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description: A number of Boone County schools have appeared in the Central Bank Great 8 Classic through the years. Hickman played in the tournament four times in the 1990s. Centralia and Harrisburg were both in the 2003 edition. Rock Bridge had a turn in 2011 and 2012, followed by Battle in 2013. Father Tolton then was a mainstay from 2014-21. The Southern Boone Eagles will finally get their turn to play in this year’s Great 8 Classic, which is scheduled from Dec. 28-30 at Fleming Fieldhouse.

item.title: California, two out-of-state squads join Jefferson Bank Select 8 Classic | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description: There will be a little something for everybody in this year’s Jefferson Bank Select 8 Classic. The Classic will feature four local teams — host Capital City, Jefferson City, Helias and new-addition California — a St. Louis school in Parkway South, a Kansas City school in Oak Park and two out-of-state teams in Har-Ber (Ark.) and Muskogee (Okla.).

item.title: Drinkwitz promises changes after Missouri's poor performance at Georgia | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description: There was no sugarcoating or excuses from Missouri coach Eli Drinkwitz on Tuesday at the weekly press conference. He is angry about his team’s most recent performance, he made that very clear and said changes are on the horizon.

item.title: Missouri football to host Cincinnati in 2027 | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description: Missouri football has found its replacement for the now-canceled Illinois game next year. The Tigers will host the Cincinnati Bearcats next season in a home-and-home series, with the second game scheduled for 2032 at Cincinnati.

item.title: Harper, Stringer resign as head coaches at Lincoln | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description: A pair of Lincoln head coaches, football coach Moses Harper and women’s soccer coach Leah Stringer, resigned late Tuesday night, according to a press release from LU Athletics. Defensive coordinator Tony Gilbert will be the interim football coach.

item.title: Finally, Blues offense powers team in 8-6 victory over Ducks
item.description: Jake Neighbours, Philip Broberg and Logan Mailleux scored in a three-minute stretch of the third period, and the St. Louis Blues held off the Anaheim Ducks 8-6.
